rule.message:
All degree-seeking students must complete the University’s Liberal Education requirements .
At least 20 upper-division credits in the major must be taken at the University of Minnesota Twin Cities campus.
All freshmen in the College of Science and Engineering must complete CSE 1001: First-Year Experience.
View  Four-year Plans  for the College of Science and Engineering.
Notes:
In addition to the sub-plans described below, students who wish to pursue a pure mathematics track or are planning to go to graduate school in mathematics should consult their advisor about appropriate course choices.
MATH 3283W, 4067W, 49xx, and MATH 5900 courses satisfy neither the upper-division mathematics course requirement nor the technical electives requirement. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.

Complete any sub-plan requirements that apply to you: Financial and Actuarial Mathematics, Computer Applications, Mathematics Education, Mathematics of Data Science, Mathematical Biology: Genomics, Mathematical Biology: Physiology, Integrated Mathematics B.S./M.S. Program, Integrated Mathematics B.S./M.F.M. Program. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
